name: TikTokDrama
meta_title: TikTokDrama – Watch Short Dramas Full Episodes Online
meta_description: Find trending short dramas and watch full episodes on official apps. Story summaries, episode info and direct links. Updated daily.
about: TikTokDrama is a free directory of trending short dramas, the vertical bite-size episodic series made for phones. Every drama page has a story summary, genre tags, episode information and a direct link to watch the full drama on the official platform such as MoboReels or ShortTV. TikTokDrama does not host or stream videos itself. The catalogue is updated daily.
